question: Will new money for the 7–8B tier (about $900–1,300 by about 20 Nov) come?
asked_by: General Implementation VIII (the lead), in the GI VIII chat's next-step box (asked at about 00:5x UTC and again at 04:55 UTC on 1 Nov 2026)
what_it_is: An expectation of new money, not money in the account. The balance was $29.91 at 23:16 UTC on 31 Oct.
lead_reading: No 7-8B or OLMo 3 pod starts before the money is in the account (the 29 Oct start-from-the-balance rule, addendum §36; the 7-8B draft's EM-2). The $6 reserve, the $10/h limit and the in-pod caps stay.

The 7-8B tier: option B (the full comparison on OLMo-2-7B and Llama-3.1-8B) stays the planned default; the gate at about 20 Nov chooses B or C by the re-plan's rule: B if the new money is in the account, the confirmation money is in sight and the noise reading allows plan A; otherwise C.

The 7-8B tier's $0 preparation becomes a planned step after the stage-1 reading, so that block 0 can start the day the money arrives: the 7-8B kit, the Llama sealed files, the noise reader, and Part 1 of the 7-8B pre-registration frozen before block 0's first pod (so before any 7-8B outcome; this replaces the lapsed freeze line).

OLMo 3 7B: 'prepare' replaces 'level 0 on 13 Nov unless the user commits option B's money'. Its probe's $0 build starts after the stage-1 reading. The lock and chat-template parts wait for the user's yes to the tokenizer download (six files, about 9.7 MB) and a separate Mac environment with transformers 4.57.1. The input choices and the pre-set answers P0-P4 are the lead's, by the draft's recommended answers, recorded before the first fine-tune. The probe pod launches by 13 Nov only on new money in the account (money check C1 on the live balance; never the money stage 1b needs).

OLMo 3 fallback: level 0 at 13 Nov 23:59 UTC. Triggers: no yes to the download and environment by 8 Nov 23:59 UTC; the build not verified by 12 Nov; or no new money in the account by 13 Nov. If builder time or usage is short, the 7-8B tier's preparation goes first (OLMo 3 is the first 7-8B model cut).
The stage-1 reading and stage 1b are unchanged: they use the current balance, in the plan's order.
